title: A Unified Response Framework for Questions and Tutoring Dialogues
abstract: arXiv:2610.19532v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing student models in educational applications largely focus on student responses to questions. However, as tutoring becomes more accessible at large scale, it is important to analyze dialogues between tutors and students, which may reveal fine-grained evidence on student knowledge. In this work, we propose a unified framework that models both student responses to questions and tutor-posed subtasks during dialogues on a shared item response theory (IRT) scale. We first identify mathematical subtasks in tutoring dialogues, rewrite them into self-contained questions, and identify the correctness of student responses to these subtasks. We then develop an IRT framework that estimates question/subtask difficulty from text, tracks students' evolving abilities across question-answering and dialogue interactions, and a novel method to leverages tutor moves between consecutive subtasks to regularize their difficulty values. translated_title: 面向问题与辅导对话的统一响应框架
translated_abstract: 现有教育应用中的学生模型主要关注学生对问题的回答。然而，随着辅导服务在大规模上日益普及，分析导师与学生之间的对话变得尤为重要，因为这些对话可能揭示关于学生知识的细粒度证据。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个统一框架，将学生对问题的回答以及辅导对话中导师提出的子任务建模在同一个项目反应理论（IRT）量表上。我们首先在辅导对话中识别数学子任务，将这些子任务改写为自包含的问题，并判定学生对这些子任务回答的正确性。随后，我们开发了一个IRT框架，从文本中估计问题/子任务的难度，追踪学生在问答和对话交互过程中不断变化的能力，并提出一种新颖的方法，利用导师在连续子任务之间的干预行为来正则化子任务的难度值。我们评估了我们的框架……
tldr: 提出了一个统一框架，将学生对问题的回答与辅导对话中导师提出的子任务共同建模在项目反应理论（IRT）量表上，通过文本估计难度、追踪学生动态能力演化，并利用导师干预行为正则化难度值，实现对学业知识的更细粒度评估。
en_tdlr: A unified framework that jointly models student responses to questions and tutor-posed subtasks in tutoring dialogues on a shared IRT scale, estimating difficulty from text, tracking evolving student abilities, and leveraging tutor moves to regularize difficulty values.
